pages.title: Required materials
pages.text: The Wafer Duplicator needs a completed source, a fresh blank wafer of the same tier, and the circuit components. Install it in a sealed cleanroom and supply power.$(br2)Supply the source design's dust, nuggets, gates, and nested wafers. The source is retained.

pages.title: Copying and output
pages.text: Each copy consumes one blank wafer and the required components. The cost is 10,000 SE multiplied by the source tier: 10,000 SE for SSI through 50,000 SE for ULSI.$(br2)Provide room in the nine output slots. Inputs lock while a result is pending. Poor cleanliness can contaminate the copy.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Use hoppers or logistics to supply blank wafers and components and extract copies. Match each nested wafer's tier and circuit design to the component used in the source.$(br2)Check the screen to identify missing supplies, then replenish materials or power, or clear output space.
